news.titleEn: Stock market today: Dow and S&P 500 drop, Nasdaq sinks over 2% as Nvidia leads AI trade lower, Anthropic IPO looms
news.conclusionEn: US stocks fell for a third straight session on Monday, with the Nasdaq down about 2.5%, the S&P 500 down about 1.9% and the Dow down about 1.4%, led by Nvidia and other AI names.
news.conclusionZh: 美股连跌三天，纳指跌约2.5%，英伟达领跌AI股
news.whyEn: The AI trade has driven most of the market's gains, so a broad sell-off in chip stocks hits index funds, retirement accounts and global tech sentiment.
news.whyZh: AI股是近年涨势主力，芯片股大跌直接拖累指数基金和全球科技股情绪
news.detailEn: Nvidia fell about 4% amid uncertainty over its leadership, while new US rules tightening chip export controls weighed on the wider semiconductor sector. Investors were also cautious ahead of Nvidia's quarterly results on Tuesday and the Anthropic IPO expected to start trading Thursday. United Airlines and major bank stocks also fell on outage-related news, while oil eased. Asian markets including mainland China and Australia slipped on Tuesday as the sell-off spread.
news.detailZh: 英伟达因管理层不确定性下跌约4%，美国收紧芯片出口管制的新规也拖累整个半导体板块。投资者在英伟达周二财报和周四Anthropic上市前普遍谨慎。美联航和大型银行股也因系统故障消息下跌，油价走低。周二亚太市场包括中国内地和澳洲股市跟跌。

news.titleEn: The tech world's calls for Jensen Huang to return to Nvidia are growing
news.conclusionEn: Calls for ousted CEO Jensen Huang to return are growing as Nvidia prepares to report quarterly results on Tuesday under interim CEO Colette Kress.
news.conclusionZh: 英伟达今天发财报，科技圈呼吁黄仁勋回归声浪渐高
news.whyEn: Nvidia is the world's most important AI chip supplier; its results and leadership outcome will set the tone for the entire AI trade and the Anthropic IPO week.
news.whyZh: 英伟达是AI芯片核心供应商，财报和CEO人选将决定整个AI板块走向
news.detailEn: Huang resigned on November 12 after reports of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of ties to Chinese intelligence. A 'Stand with Jensen' petition has nearly 180,000 signatures, backed by figures such as Elon Musk, and shareholders Altimeter and Atreides urged the board to consider all options. The Financial Times reported Huang has discussed a comeback with confidants, while Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Nvidia should look outside the company. Tuesday's fiscal third-quarter report is the first since Huang's exit.
news.detailZh: 黄仁勋11月12日因婚外情曝光辞职，其中一名女子被怀疑与中国情报机构有关。“支持黄仁勋”请愿已获近18万人签名，马斯克等人公开支持，大股东Altimeter和Atreides也要求董事会考虑所有选项。《金融时报》称黄仁勋已与亲信讨论回归，而美国财长贝森特则主张从外部找CEO。周二的财报是他离任后的首份财报。

news.titleEn: US tightens AI chip export controls to deter Chinese companies from accessing compute remotely
news.conclusionEn: The Commerce Department issued an interim rule requiring licenses to ship AI chips to any overseas data center that may provide computing power to Chinese or other restricted companies.
news.conclusionZh: 美国新规堵漏洞：海外数据中心向中企提供算力需许可
news.whyEn: It squeezes chip sales to Southeast Asia and Brazil, raises compliance costs for cloud and data center operators, and lands days before Trump meets Xi.
news.whyZh: 影响东南亚等地芯片销售和云服务商合规成本，且正值特朗普会晤习近平前夕
news.detailEn: The rule targets data centers above a set computing threshold, roughly 750 Nvidia H100-class chips, and covers indirect access through brokers. New licensing requirements apply to shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand and Brazil, which are seen as diversion risks. Existing operators have 90 days to obtain licenses, and the rule formally rescinds the Biden-era AI Diffusion Rule. It follows the Nvidia scandal and reports of chips reaching Chinese users through intermediaries.
news.detailZh: 新规针对算力超过一定门槛（约相当于750块英伟达H100）的数据中心，并覆盖通过中间商间接使用的情况。发往马来西亚、新加坡、印尼、泰国和巴西的芯片需新增许可。现有运营商有90天时间申请许可，同时正式废除拜登时期的“AI扩散规则”。此举紧随英伟达丑闻和芯片经中间商流向中国的报道。

news.titleEn: Anthropic IPO guide: Everything you need to know
news.conclusionEn: Anthropic plans to sell 825 million shares at $70–$78 each, pricing on Nov. 18 and trading on Nasdaq under ticker ANT from Thursday, Nov. 19.
news.conclusionZh: Anthropic拟周三定价、周四上市，估值约1.4万亿美元
news.whyEn: At more than $64 billion raised and a roughly $1.4 trillion valuation, it would be one of the largest IPOs ever and a key test of investor appetite for AI.
news.whyZh: 募资超640亿美元，将是史上最大IPO之一，是检验AI投资热度的关键
news.detailEn: The offering values Anthropic at about $1.405 trillion at the current price range, and up to 20% of shares are earmarked for retail investors. The deal arrives during an AI-led market sell-off and in the same week as Nvidia's earnings, adding to volatility. A strong debut could revive the IPO market for other large AI and tech companies, while a weak one could cool private AI valuations.
news.detailZh: 按当前价格区间计算，Anthropic估值约1.405万亿美元，最多20%的股份留给散户。此次上市恰逢AI股抛售，又与英伟达财报同一周，市场波动加大。如果首日表现强劲，可能带动其他大型AI和科技公司上市；如果表现疲弱，可能给一级市场的AI估值降温。

news.titleEn: China's slowdown deepens in October as industrial output, retail sales, investment miss estimates
news.conclusionEn: China's October retail sales rose just 0.4% and industrial output 4.8% year on year, both missing forecasts, while fixed-asset investment fell 8.1% in the first ten months.
news.conclusionZh: 中国10月零售仅增0.4%，工业和投资数据均逊预期
news.whyEn: Weak Chinese demand drags on global commodity prices and exporters, and raises pressure on Beijing to roll out consumer-focused stimulus.
news.whyZh: 中国内需疲弱拖累大宗商品和出口国，增加北京推出消费刺激的压力
news.detailEn: Retail sales slowed from 1.1% in September against a 0.8% forecast, and industrial output slowed from 5.5%. Property investment remains deeply negative as the real estate downturn erodes household wealth for a fifth year. Exports, by contrast, jumped 35.2% on AI-related demand, keeping the trade surplus on track for another record. Analysts say the data strengthens the case for more stimulus aimed at consumers.
news.detailZh: 零售增速从9月的1.1%放缓，低于0.8%的预期；工业增加值也从5.5%回落。房地产低迷已连续第五年侵蚀家庭财富，地产投资仍大幅下滑。相比之下，出口受AI相关需求带动大增35.2%，全年贸易顺差有望再创纪录。分析师认为，这组数据加大了推出消费刺激政策的必要性。

news.titleEn: U.S. crude oil declines to $85 a barrel on recovering Middle East exports
news.conclusionEn: Oil fell about 3.6% on Monday, with Brent at $92.44 and WTI at $85.39, as shipments through the Strait of Hormuz recovered and the IEA forecast a supply surplus.
news.conclusionZh: 霍尔木兹航运恢复，布伦特油价跌3.6%至92美元
news.whyEn: Lower oil prices ease inflation pressure and fuel costs for airlines and consumers, but hurt energy producers and oil-exporting economies.
news.whyZh: 油价回落可缓解通胀和航空、消费者成本，但对产油国和能源股不利
news.detailEn: The International Energy Agency now expects global supply to exceed demand by more than 1.7 million barrels a day in the fourth quarter, reversing its earlier deficit forecast. Russian crude output also rose in October. Goldman Sachs expects Brent to average $88 in 2027 and fall to $78 by the end of that year. Renewed Iranian attacks on Bahrain remain an upside risk to prices.
news.detailZh: 国际能源署预计第四季度全球供应将比需求多出每天170万桶以上，推翻了此前的短缺预测。俄罗斯10月原油产量也有所上升。高盛预计2027年布伦特均价为88美元，年底将跌至78美元。不过伊朗再次袭击巴林，仍是油价上行的风险因素。

news.titleEn: Iran attacks Bahrain in 'blatant challenge' to peace push
news.conclusionEn: Iran's Revolutionary Guard fired six drones at a US radar site in Bahrain, its second attack in a week, and Bahrain said all were intercepted.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗一周内二度用无人机袭击巴林美军雷达，均被拦截
news.whyEn: The attacks threaten fragile US-Iran diplomacy and Gulf shipping, and pushed Gulf stock markets lower.
news.whyZh: 袭击威胁美伊脆弱的外交进程和海湾航运，海湾股市应声下跌
news.detailEn: Bahrain issued its first nationwide emergency alert in months, and the Gulf Cooperation Council called the strike a 'blatant challenge' to regional peace efforts. Qatar and the UAE also condemned it. The IRGC claimed a tanker sank after hitting a mine in the Strait of Hormuz, which has not been verified. The 60-day window for talks under June's US-Iran agreement has expired without a deal, and Iran's foreign minister is due in Oman for talks.
news.detailZh: 巴林数月来首次发布全国紧急警报，海湾合作委员会称此次袭击是对地区和平努力的“公然挑战”，卡塔尔和阿联酋也予以谴责。伊朗革命卫队还声称一艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡触雷沉没，但尚未得到证实。6月美伊协议中的60天谈判期已到期且未达成协议，伊朗外长将赴阿曼会谈。

news.titleEn: China confirms Xi-Trump-Putin historic summit. What will be on the agenda?
news.conclusionEn: China confirmed Xi Jinping will host the first-ever three-way meeting with Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen on Thursday, on the sidelines of APEC.
news.conclusionZh: 中方确认习特普周四在深圳举行首次三方会晤
news.whyEn: Talks could touch on nuclear arms, Iran, Ukraine and the US-China trade truce that expires in January, all of which matter for markets.
news.whyZh: 议题可能涉及核裁军、伊朗、乌克兰及1月到期的中美贸易休战
news.detailEn: The White House says Trump wants to discuss reducing nuclear arsenals and the war with Iran, while Moscow sees Ukraine as a priority. Analysts expect an extension of the US-China trade truce but few concrete results, with one calling it almost entirely a photo opportunity. Trump also plans a separate meeting with Xi. The new US chip export rule announced Monday adds tension ahead of the talks.
news.detailZh: 白宫表示特朗普希望讨论削减核武器和伊朗战争，而俄方则把乌克兰问题列为优先。分析师预计中美贸易休战可能延长，但整体难有实质成果，有人称其“几乎就是合影”。特朗普还计划与习近平单独会面。美国周一公布的芯片出口新规给会谈增添了紧张气氛。

businessTips.term: Know Your Customer (KYC) & Customer Due Diligence
businessTips.explanationEn: KYC means verifying who your customers really are, who owns them and what they will do with your product before doing business. It started in banking but now applies to sensitive goods like AI chips, software and dual-use technology. Weak due diligence can turn a sale into a legal, reputational and regulatory disaster. Good KYC is a process, not a one-time form: you re-check customers when ownership or behavior changes.
businessTips.explanationZh: KYC（了解你的客户）指在做生意前核实客户的真实身份、背后股东以及产品用途。它起源于银行业，如今已扩展到AI芯片、软件和军民两用技术等敏感产品。尽职调查不到位，一笔销售可能演变成法律、声誉和监管危机。好的KYC是持续流程而非一次性表格，客户股权或行为变化时要重新审查。
businessTips.exampleEn: The new US rule requires data center operators to monitor who ultimately uses their computing power, not just who signs the contract. A small exporter can apply the same idea by checking a new overseas distributor's ownership and end customers before shipping a large order.
businessTips.exampleZh: 美国新规要求数据中心运营商监控算力的最终使用者，而不只是看签合同的是谁。小型出口商也可以照做：给新的海外经销商发大单前，先查清对方股东和终端客户。

businessTips.explanationEn: When customers pay upfront for something you have not delivered yet, such as gift vouchers, class packs or memberships, that money is a liability, not profit. You still owe the service, so spending it all early can leave you unable to deliver later. Tracking deferred revenue separately shows your real earnings and how much cash is already committed. It also builds trust, because customers are effectively lending you money.
businessTips.explanationZh: 客户为尚未交付的东西预先付款，比如礼品券、课程包或会员费，这笔钱是负债而不是利润。你仍欠着服务，如果提前花光，以后可能无法兑现。单独记录递延收入，能看清真实收益和已被占用的现金。这也关乎信任，因为客户实际上是把钱借给了你。
businessTips.exampleEn: When Australian retailer David Jones entered administration, gift card holders became unsecured creditors who may lose money. A yoga teacher selling 10-class passes should park part of the prepayment aside until classes are delivered, so a slow month never breaks promises already sold.
businessTips.exampleZh: 澳洲百货David Jones进入破产管理后，礼品卡持有人成了可能亏钱的无担保债权人。卖10次课程卡的瑜伽老师应把部分预付款留存，直到课程上完，这样即使淡季也不会违背已售出的承诺。

businessTips.explanationEn: The expected move is how far the options market prices a stock to swing after an event like earnings, usually estimated from the price of an at-the-money straddle. It shows what is already priced in, not which direction the stock will go. If the actual move is smaller than expected, option buyers lose even if they guessed the direction right. Comparing the expected move with past earnings reactions helps you judge whether risk is cheap or expensive.
businessTips.explanationZh: 预期波幅是期权市场对某事件（如财报）后股价波动幅度的定价，通常用平值跨式期权的价格估算。它反映的是市场已计入的波动，而不是涨跌方向。如果实际波动小于预期，即便方向猜对，期权买方也可能亏钱。把预期波幅与历次财报后的实际反应对比，可以判断风险定价是便宜还是昂贵。
businessTips.exampleEn: If a stock trades at $150 and the at-the-money straddle costs about $12, the market expects roughly an 8% move either way after earnings. Ahead of a high-profile report like Nvidia's, a long-term investor can use this to size positions instead of betting on the outcome.
businessTips.exampleZh: 如果股价150美元、平值跨式期权约12美元，说明市场预期财报后上下波动约8%。在英伟达这类备受关注的财报前，长期投资者可以据此控制仓位大小，而不是押注结果。
